name: Vision Scientists
description: The physics and physiology of vision — refraction, optics, accommodation, binocular vision, wavefront, aberrations, contrast sensitivity, color vision, and visual pathways.

episodes.title: The Nature of Light: Waves, Photons, and the Eye
episodes.description: How electromagnetic radiation becomes vision — wavelength, energy, and the visible spectrum.

episodes.title: Geometric Optics: Snell’s Law and the Refracting Surface
episodes.description: How light bends at interfaces — the principle behind every lens, tear film, and cornea.

episodes.title: The Thin Lens Equation: Image Formation Made Simple
episodes.description: Object distance, image distance, and focal length — the math behind every spectacle lens.

episodes.title: Spherical Lenses: Plus, Minus, and the Focal Point
episodes.description: How convex lenses converge and concave lenses diverge — the foundation of refractive correction.

episodes.title: Cylindrical Lenses: Correcting Astigmatism
episodes.description: The meridians of a cylinder, the axis, and how toric lenses restore a point image.

episodes.title: Prisms: Bending Light Without Changing Focus
episodes.description: Prism diopters, base direction, and how prisms relieve diplopia and measure deviations.

episodes.title: Vertex Distance: Why the Refraction and the Glasses Differ
episodes.description: The vertex conversion formula and why a contact lens power is not the spectacle power.

episodes.title: Accommodation: The Crystalline Lens at Work
episodes.description: The ciliary muscle, zonules, and the amplitude of accommodation that declines with age.

episodes.title: Presbyopia: The Inevitable Decline of Near Focus
episodes.description: The physiology of aging accommodation, the add progression, and the onset that surprises patients.

episodes.title: Emmetropization: How the Eye Grows to Perfect Focus
episodes.description: The developmental process that shapes the axial length and the visual feedback that guides it.

episodes.title: Myopia: The Elongated Eye and Its Consequences
episodes.description: Axial elongation, the retinal risks, and why myopia control is now a standard of pediatric care.

episodes.title: Hyperopia: The Short Eye and the Accommodative Burden
episodes.description: Latent hyperopia, the accommodative spasm, and why children with high plus present with headaches.

episodes.title: Astigmatism: The Football-Shaped Cornea
episodes.description: Corneal and lenticular astigmatism, the irregular variety, and the correction options.

episodes.title: Anisometropia: When the Two Eyes Differ
episodes.description: The aniseikonia problem, the contact lens advantage, and the amblyopia risk in children.

episodes.title: Binocular Vision: Fusion, Stereopsis, and the Cyclopean Eye
episodes.description: How two retinal images become one percept and the cortical machinery that makes it possible.
